review_kind: AI-assisted source-context review of PSF Measure intensity-source and Live processing status/help. No native-speaker sign-off.

records.key: Preview uses the loaded field and field-local normalization. Full Mask runs can use batch normalization and illumination correction, so their masks may differ. Intensity filters use the original preview pixels.
records.source: Preview uses the loaded field and field-local normalization. Full Mask runs can use batch normalization and illumination correction, so their masks may differ. Intensity filters use the original preview pixels.
records.translation: Forskoðun notar innlesið sjónsvið og stöðlun innan þess. Fullar Mask-keyrslur geta notað lotustöðlun og lýsingarleiðréttingu, svo maskar þeirra geta verið ólíkir. Styrksíur nota upprunalega mynddíla forskoðunarinnar.

records.key: Choose normal Measure intensities or calibrated PSF-processed intensities for quantitative features. PSF processing follows standard rescaling and registered preprocessing hooks. Source files and exported crops retain their existing pixels; database provenance records the choice and exact kernel. A changed kernel cannot be mixed with existing measurements.
records.source: Choose normal Measure intensities or calibrated PSF-processed intensities for quantitative features. PSF processing follows standard rescaling and registered preprocessing hooks. Source files and exported crops retain their existing pixels; database provenance records the choice and exact kernel. A changed kernel cannot be mixed with existing measurements.
records.translation: Veldu venjulegan Measure-styrk eða styrk unninn með kvörðuðu PSF fyrir megindlega eiginleika. PSF-vinnsla kemur á eftir hefðbundinni endurskölun og skráðum forvinnsluskrefum. Upprunaskrár og útfluttir myndskurðir halda sínum mynddílum; upprunaupplýsingar gagnagrunnsins skrá valið og nákvæman kjarna. Ekki má blanda breyttum kjarna við fyrirliggjandi mælingar.
